scientific_integrity: Proof is a complete finite signed-chain calculation with exact mod-two rank lower bound, a primitive integral generator, and finite-group coinvariant reasoning; computation is supplied as a fully executable independent reconstruction of the stated finite object.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the fixed complex Ind(C16(1,4,8)), with integral top homology and a rational ordinary symmetry quotient. It does not establish integral quotient homology, quotient homotopy type, or a uniform theorem for all circulants. Unindexed equivalent prior results remain a potential priority risk; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
title: The all-facet primitive three-cycle of an exceptional circulant independence complex
